name: Mayor of Kingstown
description: In a small Michigan town where the business of incarceration is the only thriving industry, the McClusky family are the power brokers between the police, criminals, inmates, prison guards and politicians in a city completely dependent on prisons and the prisoners they contain.

videos.title: The Mayor of Kingstown
videos.overview: Brothers Mitch and Mike McLusky navigate Kingstown, home to multiple prisons, as they act as the liaisons between prisoners and the community. When a young guard, Sam, is set up to deliver a letter for a prisoner, Mike works to get him off the hook.

videos.title: The End Begins
videos.overview: Local gang leader, Bunny is upset when one of his guys gets taken off the yard. Mike brokers a deal, and is later visited by two FBI agents whom Mitch worked for. Milo has instructions for Josef on how to get closer to Mike.

videos.title: Simply Murder
videos.overview: After a tragic accident has deadly consequences, an all-out manhunt ensues. Meanwhile, Mike reaches out to a former prison contact.

videos.title: The Price
videos.overview: Everyone wants something from Mike, who reminds them who is in control. Iris visits Mike’s office. Mariam and Mike discuss Kyle’s future.

videos.title: Orion
videos.overview: Kyle and Ian are questioned by internal affairs in the wake of the shootout. Bunny asks Mike for help with a close family member.

videos.title: Every Feather
videos.overview: When a fight breaks out on the yard, Sam finds himself in trouble again. Milo goes to extreme lengths to get what he wants. Mike sends a message.

videos.title: Along Came a Spider
videos.overview: Mike pays Milo a visit, looking for answers. Tensions at the men’s prison reach a boiling point. Mike makes a disturbing discovery.

videos.title: The Devil Is Us
videos.overview: Kyle and Kingstown PD try to make sense of the crime scene. Mike takes matters into his own hands. Sam makes a costly mistake.

videos.title: The Lie of the Truth
videos.overview: Tracy has good news for Kyle. Mike and Iris spend a peaceful day at the cabin, unaware of the trouble escalating back in town.

videos.title: This Piece of My Soul
videos.overview: Kingstown Prison descends into total chaos. Mike desperately works to help stop a riot that will have serious consequences for all involved.

videos.title: Never Missed a Pigeon
videos.overview: In the wake of the Kingstown Prison riot, violence and chaos ensue in the newly formed tent city. Mike and Bunny discuss what must be done to solve the leadership void on the inside. Kyle begins his new job with the Michigan State Police.

videos.title: Staring at the Devil
videos.overview: After a power vacuum in tent city spills out into Kingstown, Mike makes a bold move to try and restore order. Iris is uneasy about her new living arrangement. Kyle finds himself in a dangerous situation.

videos.title: Five at Five
videos.overview: Mike asks for help in finding Iris, and later takes matters into his own hands. A move by Robert and his team puts Mike's larger plan in jeopardy. Kyle has a request for Kingstown PD.

videos.title: The Pool
videos.overview: Mike increases pressure on Evelyn to honor her side of the deal before another unexpected event at tent city. Bunny worries Mike has lost control. Mariam attempts an act of good will.

videos.title: Kill Box
videos.overview: In the wake of the tent city transfer, Mike finds himself in a race to locate Bunny. Kareem surveys the new power structure, and later gets some unsettling news. Kyle contemplates his next move. Milo looks to fix Joseph's mistake.

videos.title: Left with the Nose
videos.overview: Mike leverages a favor with the new powers in charge. Bunny finds himself short on patience as Anchor Bay becomes increasingly volatile. Kyle and Mike have a heart to heart. Robert gets some troubling news.

videos.title: Drones
videos.overview: Robert, Kyle, and Ian look to get their story straight as the internal affairs investigation looms. In the wake of Lockett's murder, Mike and Evelyn's relationship grows tense. Mike takes care of a problem for Bunny. Tracy worries about Kyle.

videos.title: Santa Jesus
videos.overview: Mike spends his version of a day off the grid. Ian goes to great lengths to solve a problem. Bunny has a gift for Raphael. Milo speaks to Iris alone.

videos.title: Peace in the Valley
videos.overview: Mike and Milo discuss a possible trade. Bunny makes a brazen move and later has a demand for Mike. Mariam looks to track down Jacob. Evelyn is livid with Mike.

videos.title: Little Green Ant
videos.overview: It's all hands on deck as the war spills out into the streets of Kingstown. A mistake has serious repercussions. The trust between Mike and Bunny reaches a moment of truth. Iris finds herself with nowhere else to go.

videos.title: Soldier's Heart
videos.overview: Tensions are high as tragedy strikes in Kingstown. Meanwhile, a new face of the Russian mob sets up shop in the city.

videos.title: Guts
videos.overview: Anchor Bay gets a new inmate as Mike investigates recent deaths both inside and outside of prison walls.

videos.title: Barbarians at the Gate
videos.overview: The Mayor makes his presence known to Konstantin. Bunny brings Mike up to speed on a failed assassination attempt.

videos.title: Rag Doll
videos.overview: Desperate to confirm the source of a spate of bombings, Mike extends an unlikely olive branch.

videos.title: Iris
videos.overview: Danger erupts when Iris confronts her past. The Mayor finds a new chess piece as Bunny and Konstantin's rivalry reaches new heights.

videos.title: Ecotone
videos.overview: After an attack hits close to home, Mike is given an ultimatum that could change everything.

videos.title: Marya Was Here
videos.overview: An incident on the bridge raises questions across Kingstown. Mike sets a risky plan in motion.

videos.title: Captain of the Sh*t Out of Luck
videos.overview: Anchor Bay is attacked from outside its prison walls. Mike takes care of some important business at Kingstown Women's Prison.

videos.title: Home on the Range
videos.overview: Unfinished business haunts Kingstown as the Crips seek revenge at the hospital.

videos.title: Comeuppance
videos.overview: Mike's plan for the warring factions in Kingstown hits turbulence.

videos.title: Coming 'Round the Mountain
videos.overview: Mike works every angle to protect his brother.

videos.title: Promises to Keep
videos.overview: Mike sends the prison a message and considers an offer from a legend.

videos.title: People Who Died
videos.overview: Mike and Ian discover a coverup that leads to an unexpected source.

videos.title: Sins of Omission
videos.overview: Confronted with the cartel's unexpected strength, Mike responds.

videos.title: Damned
videos.overview: New dangers threaten Mike's family as Callahan comes back into focus.
The cartel war reaches new heights as Mike makes a bargain with the devil.

videos.title: My Way
videos.overview: Mike hatches a plan, saddling Ian with an agonizing task.

videos.title: Belleville
videos.overview: Mike lays a dangerous trap while a prison break puts the town in peril.

videos.title: Teeth and Tissue
videos.overview: After tragedy strikes, Mike risks everything to save his brother.

videos.title: Belly of the Beast
videos.overview: Mike fights to prevent Kyle from following in his footsteps.
